driverFormulas.rev: Total Revenue = Patient Care Revenue − Payer Discounts & Settlements
driverFormulas.cogs: Cost of Care = Medical Supplies & Catering + Clinical Workforce + Facility & Third-Party Services
driverFormulas.gp: Care Contribution = Total Revenue − Cost of Care
driverFormulas.gp-pct: Care Contribution % = Care Contribution / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.opex-excl: Operating Expenses = Admissions & Payer Contracting + IT & Digital Therapy + Administration & Corporate
driverFormulas.ebitda-pct: EBITDA Margin % = EBITDA / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.da: Depreciation & Amortisation = Clinic Estate & Equipment + Leased Sites + Software
driverFormulas.ebit-pct: EBIT Margin % = EBIT / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.nonop: Net Financial Result = Interest Income − Finance Costs + Other Financial
driverFormulas.ebt: Profit Before Tax = EBIT + Net Financial Result
driverFormulas.ni: Net Income = Profit Before Tax − Tax
driverFormulas.ni-pct: Net Margin % = Net Income / Total Revenue x 100
driverFormulas.bs-assets: Total Assets = Current Assets + Non-Current Assets
driverFormulas.bs-ca: Current Assets = Cash + Receivables + Medical Stock + Prepaids
driverFormulas.bs-inv: Medical & Catering Stock = Medical Consumables + Pharmacy + Catering
driverFormulas.bs-nca: Non-Current Assets = Property & Equipment + Accum. Depreciation + Goodwill + Other
driverFormulas.bs-liab-eq: Total Liabilities & Equity = Current Liabilities + Non-Current Liabilities + Equity
driverFormulas.bs-cl: Current Liabilities = Payables + Accruals + ST Borrowings + Payer Advances
driverFormulas.bs-ncl: Non-Current Liabilities = Term Loans + Deferred Tax + Pensions & Other
driverFormulas.bs-equity: Equity = Share Capital + Retained Earnings + OCI
driverFormulas.cfo: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = Net Income + D&A + Working Capital
driverFormulas.cfi: Cash Flow from Investing Activities = CapEx + Disposals + Acquisitions
driverFormulas.cff: Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Borrowings + Lease Payments + Distributions
driverFormulas.cf-net: Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
driverFormulas.cf-end-cash: Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
